patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: Thirty years of fishing and never once. My buddy cast into the wind and now I'm the catch of the day. He's out in the car laughing.
clinical.presentationShort: 63yo M — barbed fishhook embedded in the index finger pulp. NV intact, no joint or tendon involvement, tetanus current.
clinical.presentationLong: 63-year-old male with a barbed fishhook embedded in the pulp of the index finger, neurovascularly intact with no joint or tendon involvement.

diagnosis.primary: Retained barbed fishhook in the soft tissue of the finger
diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → digital block, string-yank or advance-and-cut removal, dressing
diagnosis.why: Local anaesthetic and whichever removal technique you prefer. Only an eye, a joint or a tendon turns a fishhook into something bigger than Fast Track.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 63-year-old man in a fishing vest and cap, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with one hand held carefully upright, the other steadying the wrist
aiImageGeneration.expression: wry, embarrassed and entirely unbothered by the pain
signs: a small fishhook caught in the pad of the index finger
a fishing vest covered in small tackle
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 63-year-old man in a fishing vest and cap, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with one hand held carefully upright, the other steadying the wrist. Expression: wry, embarrassed and entirely unbothered by the pain. Clearly visible: a small fishhook caught in the pad of the index finger; a fishing vest covered in small tackle. Overall: entirely well and quite amused. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
